title: Paying for drops
summary: Your first drop is free. After that, each drop is ₦10,000, whatever its size, or buy a season pack.

steps.title: Your first drop is free
steps.body: Your first drop is free, up to 1,000 Tikkas. Your business page is always free.

steps.title: After that, one price per drop
steps.body: Each drop after your first is ₦10,000, for 40 Tikkas or 900. Founding members pay ₦5,000. You see the price on the publish button before you pay, like "Pay ₦10,000 and publish". Adding more Tikkas to a running drop is free, up to 1,000. For more than 1,000 Tikkas in one drop, talk to us.

steps.title: Pay by card or bank transfer
steps.body: Tikka uses Paystack, so you can pay by card or bank transfer. Your drop goes live as soon as the payment comes through. Tikka never sees your card number.

steps.title: Season packs
steps.body: A season pack is 3 drops paid at once: ₦25,000, or ₦12,000 for founding members. Buy one in Payments (on a phone: More, then Payments). Each drop you publish after that uses one, and the button says "Publish with your season pack".

tips: Every payment you've made is listed in Payments.
If a paid drop brings fewer than 10 customers, your next drop is free (once).
